verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Intuit Intelligence, a built-in chat assistant you can tell to create invoices, resolve anomalies, run payroll, generate reports and estimate tax savings, with instant answers to questions about your books. Specialized agents back this up: Payroll AI collects time data and flags inconsistencies, Payments AI sends invoice reminders, and an AI generator drafts invoices for review. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks actually complete as claimed, and in-depth documentation beyond marketing pages (autonomy limits, approval steps, which tasks it can execute end-to-end).
